oil.name: OIL
oil.description: The barrel the whole continent runs on. Every refinery, every tank of fuel and every shop mark-up is quoted off this line.

souls.name: SOUL
souls.description: Crystallised essence, traded by weight. It drifts back to the resonance median no matter what the floor thinks it is worth.
